{{CharInfobox |color={{jump color}} |corecolor={{jump color light}} |bordercolor={{jump color dark}} |name=Kyle |jname=カイト |tmname=Kaito |slogan=no |image=Kyle Sinnoh.png |size=230px |caption=Kyle |gender=Male |region=[[Sinnoh]] |colors=yes |eyes=Blue |hair=Brown |relatives=Unknown |trainer=yes |trainerclass={{pkmn|Coordinator}} |game=no |leader=no |team=no |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=DP077 |epname=Staging a Heroes Welcome! |enva=[[Jamie McGonnigal]] |java=[[Hirofumi Nojima]] }} '''Kyle''' (Japanese: '''カイト''' ''Kaito'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is a [[Pokémon Coordinator]] who participated in the [[Wallace Cup]] that was held on the shore of [[Lake Valor]]. ==History== Kyle first appeared in ''[[DP077|Staging a Heroes Welcome!]]'' as a brief cameo. He was one of the Coordinators who participated in the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]]. Using {{p|Cloyster}}, he was able to get to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]]. In ''[[DP078|Pruning a Passel of Pals!]]'', Kyle had a real major appearance in the episode where he battled {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Buizel}} in the Battle Stage. He pointed out how the other participants used different {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} since the first round and Ash kept on using Buizel. As such, Kyle predicted what Ash was going to do in the match. Despite Ash perfecting Buizel's [[Contest combination|Ice Aqua Jet technique]], it was not enough and Kyle won the match. Kyle then went up against {{an|Dawn}} in the semifinals. Their battle started in ''[[DP079|Strategy with a Smile!]]''. Despite his {{p|Crawdaunt}} knowing some powerful moves and being fully [[Evolution|evolved]], he and Crawdaunt lost to Dawn and her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}} as Piplup's {{m|Bide}} unleashed double the power back at Crawdaunt. As such, Kyle was knocked out of the competition, placing in the Top 4, being the highest-placed male Coordinator. ==Character== Kyle was shown to be a very confident person, as shown with his battle against {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Buizel}}. He was also a strong Coordinator in the Wallace Cup as he was able to get past many of the participants until his battle with {{an|Dawn}}. Unlike the other participants in the tournament who battled Ash, he was the only one who pointed out Ash's strategy of using only Buizel throughout the tournament instead of multiple Pokémon and had chosen his Pokémon for the round to counter Buizel, which made Ash react angrily. Because of this and Ash getting preoccupied with the situation, he was able to defeat Ash despite being caught off-guard by Buizel's Ice Aqua Jet combination. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} This listing is of Kyle's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kyle |pkmn=Cloyster |type1=Water |type2=Ice |img=Kyle Cloyster.png |epnum=DP077 |epname=Staging a Heroes Welcome! |desc=Kyle's {{p|Cloyster}} made a brief appearance in ''[[DP077|Staging a Heroes Welcome!]]'', where it was used in the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]], using Spike Cannon to impress the audience. Cloyster's only known move is {{m|Spike Cannon}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kyle |pkmn=Lanturn |type1=Water |type2=Electric |img=Kyle Lanturn.png |epnum=DP078 |epname=Pruning a Passel of Pals! |desc={{p|Lanturn}} was used in the [[Wallace Cup]] against {{Ash}} and {{AP|Buizel}}. Despite Ash and Buizel's determination to win, Kyle was able to easily dominate the match. However, by launching an Ice Beam, Lanturn unexpectedly helped Buizel use Ice Aqua Jet, a [[Contest combination|combination]] that Dawn had unsuccessfully attempted to teach him. This made Kyle lose a lot of points, though it wasn't enough and the time ran out, leaving Kyle victorious. Lanturn's known moves are {{m|Charge}}, {{m|Thunderbolt}}, {{m|Ice Beam}}, and {{m|Hydro Pump}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Kyle |pkmn=Crawdaunt |type1=Water |type2=Dark |img=Kyle Crawdaunt.png |epnum=DP079 |epname=Strategy With a Smile! |vaen=Ted Lewis{{!}}Ed Paul |desc=Kyle used {{p|Crawdaunt}} in the semifinals against {{an|Dawn}} and her {{TP|Dawn|Piplup}}. When {{p|Piplup}} launched a {{m|Whirlpool}}, Crawdaunt was able take control of the water by using Surf and Dark Pulse. Kyle then called for Crawdaunt to use Crabhammer, but Piplup had been using a spinning {{m|Bide}} to absorb the previous Dark Pulse attack. When Crawdaunt got close to use Crabhammer, Piplup unleashed the Bide energy and knocked out its opponent, putting Dawn through to the finals.
